summary: MapLight Therapeutics filed an 8-K to disclose topline Phase 2 trial results for ML-004 in autism spectrum disorder via a conference call, presentation, and press release. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved. This is a routine clinical update disclosure, not a special situation. The filing merely reports operational progress and does not trigger any corporate event category.
